label: Cap shift census
title: How far does complement conjugation move a local cap, over all 256 rules?
kind: Exact census of cap-radius shifts under complement conjugation, R ≤ 4
summary: O-coordinate caps are exactly complement-invariant at every radius. K caps shift by 0, 1 or 2, never above h+1, with the only shift-2 cells at 132↔222 and 160↔250. No cell is half-decided at R ≤ 4; the transformation moves radii but never creates or destroys a cap.
takeaway: Complement conjugation is invisible to the O tuple and costs at most two units of radius for the K tuple. The h=0 cap set coincides with the derivative-closure set, an exact post-hoc observation.
